tasks.title: 💎 Premium
tasks.content:
20 premium features and 10x the list and task capacity on all platforms, empowering you to achieve more goals and possibilities.

[✌️ Learn about Premium](https://ticktick.com/about/upgrade?from=welcome)

tasks.title: ✨ More unique features
tasks.content:
Here are some of our unique features:

 - **Cross-platform support**: we support nearly all devices and operating systems, including phones, computers, and watches.  [👀 Check out our supported platforms](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055780388337090560)

 - **Collaboration**: Need to work on a project with colleagues? Quickly invite them to join your list and easily assign tasks to members.[🤝 How to share a list](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055781706355179520)

- **Tag**: Want to personalize task management? Try adding tags to tasks for easy categorization and filtering, making management more convenient.[🏷️ How to use tags](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055782255804809216)

- **Filter**: Need to view all high-priority tasks? Try the Filter feature to effortlessly screen the tasks you want to see.[🚀 How to use filters](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055782240994721792)

- **Summary**: Still, pondering over your review content? Try the Summary feature to easily grasp the completion status of tasks over a specific period. [📋 How to use Summary](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055780476358754304#summary)

- **Command Menu**: Want to quickly navigate to different modules? Simply use the command menu (Ctrl/Command+K) to go there effortlessly. [⌨️ Explore more shortcuts](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055780449171275776)

tasks.title: 🍅 Pomodoro: Rescue from procrastination
tasks.content:
If you have procrastination tendencies, give the Pomodoro feature a try. The sense of achievement gained from completing individual Pomodoro sessions can help you achieve more goals.

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/pomodoro.mp4)

tasks.title: 📅 Calendar: Check your schedule
tasks.content:
The key to time management lies not only in reminders and memos but also in having a good plan. Our calendar views help you schedule events and appointments efficiently.

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/calendar.mp4)

tasks.title: ✅ Click the input box to create a task
tasks.content:
If you often forget what you must do, try writing them down, setting reminders, and freeing up your mind.

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/task.mp4)

tasks.title: ⏰ Habit: Visualize your efforts
tasks.content:
If you struggle to stick to good habits, consider exploring this feature! Your check-in records and data analytics will witness your persistence and growth.

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/habit.mp4)

tasks.title: 📋 Use lists to manage tasks
tasks.content:
As the number of tasks grows, you can use lists to categorize and organize them.

- **Inbox**: Where your temporary ideas and tasks gather.
- **Smart List**: Tasks with due dates will intelligently appear in the "Today" and "Next 7 Days" lists, providing a clear overview of what needs to be done each day.
- **List**: You can also add lists to manage tasks (such as work, life, etc.) according to your usage habits.

[💡 Learn the list features](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055782283059396608)

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/list.mp4)

tasks.title: 🎯 Eisenhower Matrix: Prioritize tasks
tasks.content:
If you have a lot to do every day, using the Eisenhower Matrix feature can help you focus on important and urgent tasks.

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/matrix.mp4)

tasks.title: 🔗 Subscription Calendar: Never miss events
tasks.content:
Tired of the constant back-and-forth between calendar apps for schedule checks? Consider trying out the Calendar Subscription feature—effortlessly subscribe to calendars including Google, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, and more.

[💡 How to subscribe to the calendar](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055781593733922816)

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/subscription.mp4)

tasks.title: 📊 Kanban, Timeline View: Visual management
tasks.content:
Efficiently switch between list views for better task management.

- **Kanban View**: Need categorized tasks? Use Kanban View for clear category presentation in card format. [💡 Learn about Kanban View](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055782353376903168)

- **Timeline View**: Tracking long-term projects? Try Timeline View. Easily visualize task timelines and effortlessly adjust plans with a simple drag-and-drop.  [💡 Learn about Timeline View](https://help.ticktick.com/articles/7055782331050622976)

![file](https://pull.ticktick.com/newuser3/desktop/en/view.mp4)
